title: Arizer XQ2 Heater Cover Screen Pack
description:
Upgrade your Arizer XQ2 with the XQ2 Heater Cover Screen Pack, designed for optimal airflow and superior vapor quality. Made from high-quality stainless steel, these durable screens fit seamlessly into your XQ2 glass heater cover, ensuring a clean and efficient vaping experience. This Arizer XQ2 heater cover screen pack includes four replacement screens, making it an essential accessory for maintaining your vaporizer.

Whether you’re replacing worn-out screens or keeping extras on hand, this glass heater cover screen pack keeps your sessions smooth. Shop now and enhance your Arizer XQ2 performance! Check out our reviews for customer feedback.
